messages.subject: stat_bin cumulative counts
parts:
I was wondering if stat_bin could be made to create some additional
variables reflecting the cumulative counts or density such
as ..cum_counts.. or ..cum_density.. . This would let me immediately
look at CDFs without any extra work.

Is there an existing way to get this behaviour that I should be using?

Thanks,

Pat
